Third, two rows had incorrect Revenue values (1805 instead of 18) and were corrected to Revenue = Quantity * Price. After these fixes, the analysis shows: Accessories: 7 orders, Electronics: 20 orders, Furniture: 11 orders, Office Supplies: 21 orders.
